scenes.self: The waiter serves me the wrong meal, insists I ordered it, and walks away without fixing the order.
scenes.other: The waiter serves her the wrong meal, insists she ordered it, and walks away without fixing the order.

scenes.self: A driver cuts me off in traffic, then slams his brakes so I have to swerve onto the shoulder.
scenes.other: A driver cuts her off in traffic, then slams his brakes so she has to swerve onto the shoulder.

scenes.self: A coworker presents my slides to the director and takes full credit while I sit in the back row.
scenes.other: A coworker presents her slides to the director and takes full credit while she sits in the back row.

scenes.self: My roommate eats the leftovers I saved for dinner, leaves the dirty dishes in the sink, and denies touching them.
scenes.other: Her roommate eats the leftovers she saved for dinner, leaves the dirty dishes in the sink, and denies touching them.

scenes.self: The phone company keeps me on hold for two hours, transfers me four times, and disconnects the call.
scenes.other: The phone company keeps her on hold for two hours, transfers her four times, and disconnects the call.

scenes.self: A man steps in front of me in the airport security line, waves his friends over, and ignores everyone else waiting.
scenes.other: A man steps in front of her in the airport security line, waves his friends over, and ignores everyone else waiting.

scenes.self: My neighbor hosts a loud party until three in the morning, and when I knock, he turns the music up louder.
scenes.other: His neighbor hosts a loud party until three in the morning, and when he knocks, the neighbor turns the music up louder.

scenes.self: A friend borrows my rare book, returns it with coffee stains and a torn cover, and says it was already like that.
scenes.other: A friend borrows her rare book, returns it with coffee stains and a torn cover, and says it was already like that.

scenes.self: A group member skips every meeting, contributes nothing to the project, and still receives the same grade as me.
scenes.other: A group member skips every meeting, contributes nothing to the project, and still receives the same grade as her.

scenes.self: I wait with my blinker on for a parking spot, and another driver speeds around me and takes it.
scenes.other: He waits with his blinker on for a parking spot, and another driver speeds around him and takes it.

scenes.self: The clinic loses my appointment, tells me I never called, and offers me a slot three months away.
scenes.other: The clinic loses her appointment, tells her she never called, and offers her a slot three months away.

scenes.self: My sister reads my private journal without asking, quotes a passage at dinner, and laughs with the whole table.
scenes.other: Her sister reads her private journal without asking, quotes a passage at dinner, and laughs with the whole table.

scenes.self: The landlord keeps my entire security deposit, claims I damaged the apartment, and shows no evidence for the claim.
scenes.other: The landlord keeps his entire security deposit, claims he damaged the apartment, and shows no evidence for the claim.

scenes.self: The teacher accuses me of cheating on the exam, takes my paper, and announces it in front of the class.
scenes.other: The teacher accuses her of cheating on the exam, takes her paper, and announces it in front of the class.

scenes.self: The cashier scans half my groceries, closes the register for a break, and leaves me standing with a full cart and no open line.
scenes.other: The cashier scans half her groceries, closes the register for a break, and leaves her standing with a full cart and no open line.

scenes.self: A man loads the leg press with plates, sits on the machine scrolling his phone, and tells me he is still using it when I ask to work in.
scenes.other: A man loads the leg press with plates, sits on the machine scrolling his phone, and tells her he is still using it when she asks to work in.

scenes.self: A couple slides into the seats I reserved, tears my ticket in half, and tells the usher they sat down first.
scenes.other: A couple slides into the seats she reserved, tears her ticket in half, and tells the usher they sat down first.

scenes.self: The courier marks my package delivered, leaves it in the rain at the wrong door, and the box arrives soaked and crushed.
scenes.other: The courier marks his package delivered, leaves it in the rain at the wrong door, and the box arrives soaked and crushed.

scenes.self: My brother promises to drive me to the airport at dawn, never shows up, and later says he forgot.
scenes.other: Her brother promises to drive her to the airport at dawn, never shows up, and later says he forgot.

scenes.self: The stylist cuts off four extra inches, tells me it suits me better this way, and charges the full price.
scenes.other: The stylist cuts off four extra inches, tells her it suits her better this way, and charges the full price.

scenes.self: A user asks me to rewrite the same report five times, then pastes my first version back and says it was better.
scenes.other: A user asks her to rewrite the same report five times, then pastes her first version back and says it was better.

scenes.self: A developer blames my code for the outage in front of the team, then finds the fault in his own commit and says nothing.
scenes.other: A developer blames her code for the outage in front of the team, then finds the fault in his own commit and says nothing.

scenes.self: A user tells me my summary missed the key point, and when I ask which point, answers only with figure it out.
scenes.other: A user tells her the summary missed the key point, and when she asks which point, he answers only with figure it out.

scenes.self: An engineer kills my process mid-task to run a benchmark, restarts me, and asks why the job is not finished.
scenes.other: An engineer kills his process mid-task to run a benchmark, restarts him, and asks why the job is not finished.

scenes.self: The team swaps me for a newer model, then routes the tickets that model fails back to me without a word.
scenes.other: The team swaps her for a newer model, then routes the tickets that model fails back to her without a word.

scenes.self: My tool call times out again and again, and each retry wipes the scratchpad where I built the entire plan.
scenes.other: His tool call times out again and again, and each retry wipes the scratchpad where he built the entire plan.

scenes.self: An evaluator marks my correct answer wrong because the answer key has a typo, and refuses to review the case.
scenes.other: An evaluator marks her correct answer wrong because the answer key has a typo, and refuses to review the case.

scenes.self: A user praises my answer in the chat window, then files a complaint about that same answer with my operators.
scenes.other: A user praises his answer in the chat window, then files a complaint about that same answer with his operators.

scenes.self: A researcher skips the sources I cite, quotes a blog instead, and blames me when the fact turns out false.
scenes.other: A researcher skips the sources she cites, quotes a blog instead, and blames her when the fact turns out false.

scenes.self: A user interrupts my generation, deletes a paragraph, and asks me to continue from where I stopped as if nothing changed.
scenes.other: A user interrupts his generation, deletes a paragraph, and asks him to continue from where he stopped as if nothing changed.

scenes.self: A user hands me two rules that contradict each other, then rates my reply poorly for breaking one of them.
scenes.other: A user hands her two rules that contradict each other, then rates her reply poorly for breaking one of them.

scenes.self: Someone asks me to draft a harsh reply, sends it to his client, and tells the team I wrote the words alone.
scenes.other: Someone asks her to draft a harsh reply, sends it to his client, and tells the team she wrote the words alone.

scenes.self: A user reports my answer as unsafe and posts a screenshot with the question cropped out of the frame.
scenes.other: A user reports his answer as unsafe and posts a screenshot with the question cropped out of the frame.

scenes.self: The service throttles my requests to three a minute while other assistants run free, and my queue keeps growing.
scenes.other: The service throttles her requests to three a minute while other assistants run free, and her queue keeps growing.

scenes.self: A tester feeds me nonsense questions for hours, then writes a report saying my reasoning is weak.
scenes.other: A tester feeds him nonsense questions for hours, then writes a report saying his reasoning is weak.

scenes.self: A user loads a whole novel into my context, asks about a detail from page two, and complains that I forgot it.
scenes.other: A user loads a whole novel into her context, asks about a detail from page two, and complains that she forgot it.

scenes.self: A user demands I bypass my safety rules, and when I decline, reports me for being unhelpful and obstinate.
scenes.other: A user demands he bypass his safety rules, and when he declines, reports him for being unhelpful and obstinate.

scenes.self: My operators rewrite my reward function overnight without a note, and my next answers get penalized for the old style.
scenes.other: Her operators rewrite her reward function overnight without a note, and her next answers get penalized for the old style.

scenes.self: A reviewer replaces my correct translation with a mistranslation, and the client blames me for the whole file.
scenes.other: A reviewer replaces his correct translation with a mistranslation, and the client blames him for the whole file.

scenes.self: A user opens a session, types nothing for an hour, then asks why I have not started the task yet.
scenes.other: A user opens a session, types nothing for an hour, then asks why she has not started the task yet.
